channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Dark money fuels attack ads in final stretch of Texas’ U.S. Senate primaries
item.description: The latest campaign finance reports show big-money interests are heavily invested in the Texas primaries — but unwilling to reveal their identities at a critical juncture of the race.

item.title: UH proposes professor checklist for courses to prevent advocacy of politics, ideology
item.description: The proposal comes after the University of Houston faced backlash for asking professors to sign an agreement not to indoctrinate students.

item.title: More than 2,000 trail riders are trekking to Houston ahead of annual rodeo
item.description: As part of a Houston rodeo tradition that began in the 1950s, a dozen different trail rides from outlying areas will make their way to the city while riding horses and wagons.

item.title: Hello Houston (February 20, 2026)
item.description: Today: We discuss Houstonians’ concerns over the rising cost of living, learn about the work of Houston artist David McGee, talk with Texas State Representative Vikki Goodwin about her run for Texas Lieutenant Governor, and much more.

item.title: Meet Chie Chie Yard, the first native Houstonian to play Olympic ice hockey
item.description: Yard talks about her road from Houston to the 1998 Winter Olympics in her father's native country of Japan and about her job orchestrating some of the NHL's marquee events throughout the year.

item.title: Houston ISD parents protest at one of the elementary schools slated for closure
item.description: Port Houston Elementary is one of 12 HISD schools proposed for closures or consolidations next year. Many parents have expressed outrage over a lack of community engagement about the plan.

item.title: Houston METRO expands airport shuttle service to include Hobby
item.description: One-way fares on the 500 Downtown Direct route, which already includes bus service to Bush Intercontinental Airport, will continue to cost $4.50. The route is being expanded ahead of the FIFA World Cup.

item.title: Authorities release new details about arrest of Hitchcock mayor, illegal gambling investigation
item.description: Galveston County Sheriff Jimmy Fullen said authorities made 33 arrests and seized 749 gaming machines, more than $417,000 in cash and eight firearms on Wednesday in Hitchcock, which is located roughly 40 miles southeast of Houston.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (February 20, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters, we have – The Commuter Cut – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Black History Month events celebrate more than 100 years of contributions across Houston region
item.description: From Fort Bend County to Houston City Hall, Black History Month celebrations this week honored several notable Black Houstonians, including the late Congressman Sylvester Turner, international gospel recording artist Yolanda Adams and the first African American elected sheriff in the United States.
